newsitem.title: UK: BOE ,council houses likely for early UK legislation.
newsitem.headline: BOE ,council houses likely for early UK legislation.

text.p: Bills to give the Bank of England control over interest rates and to allow local authorities to spend the capital receipts from sales of council houses are set to be introduced early in the upcoming parliamentary session, government sources said on Monday.
They also named bills to reduce class sizes for younger children and to pave the way for referenda on devolution to Scotland and Wales as likely to be published quickly.
"They are pretty certain candidates for early rather than late," a source in Prime Minister Tony Blair's office said.
The new session of parliament begins on Wednesday with Queen Elizabeth formally reading a speech about future legislative plans written for her by ministers.
Some 20 bills are expected to be announced in the speech. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
